mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over 3 consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases over 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals a consumption-driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the same month, it signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > +200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > +200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a pivot towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5%.
